title: Bar Salts Grape Flavour Concentrate 30ml By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Grape flavour concentrate offers a robust and deep grape flavour, encapsulated in a 30ml bottle. This 100% PG concentrate allows DIY vapers to mix a custom vape juice that brings the lush, full-bodied taste of ripe grapes to their vaping experience. Suitable for those who prefer a straightforward yet impactful flavour profile, this concentrate is an essential addition to any DIY mixing kit. Mix this concentrate with a VG/PG base of your choice and add nicotine shots as desired to achieve your perfect vape, with recommended dilution rates between 15-20% to suit your taste. Produced in the UK, this high-quality concentrate is designed for optimal flavour accuracy and mixing versatility. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
